cards.name: The Fool
cards.meaning: New beginnings, innocence, and a sense of adventure.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.meaning: Solitude, search for personal truth, and introspection.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.meaning: Cycles, change, and life's ups and downs.

moonPhases.name: New Moon
moonPhases.energy: Initiation. Plant seeds, set intentions, begin quietly.

moonPhases.name: Waxing Crescent
moonPhases.energy: First steps. Act on what you seeded at the new moon.

moonPhases.name: First Quarter
moonPhases.energy: Decision. Face what is blocking you and push through it.

moonPhases.name: Waxing Gibbous
moonPhases.energy: Refinement. Adjust, improve, prepare for the peak.

moonPhases.name: Full Moon
moonPhases.energy: Culmination. Release what is finished. Emotions run high.

moonPhases.name: Waning Gibbous
moonPhases.energy: Gratitude. Share what you have learned with others.

moonPhases.name: Last Quarter
moonPhases.energy: Release. Let go of what no longer serves the next cycle.

moonPhases.name: Waning Crescent
moonPhases.energy: Rest. Surrender, integrate, prepare for the dark.
